algorithms: reuse frozen joint_baselines.py definitions, priors, ties, fallback and public 64-vector/mask contract
fit_data: only that fold's fit_root_ids; preserve original source_split separately
check_data: only that fold's check_root_ids; exclude held family from fit; original global split is not the fold role
policy_inputs: public 64-vector and 8-action mask only; no fold ID, root/family ID or held response table
scoring: held-family records only; every root is checked once per policy/seed/cost; count seeds as repeats
paired_comparison: compare cost to native rule only when all outcomes match the required semantic terminal contract; otherwise cost delta is null
configuration_selection: none; no tuning from fold scores; all 16 folds execute under this one fixed protocol
learning: empirical response prior reconstructed per fold; no PPO, neural BC, SFT or checkpoint updates
scope: internal reuse of 48 already-inspected synthetic worlds, not an independent final evaluation
